author: Benzit0
title: Disappointed
content:
I’ve invested a lot of time and money into FC Mobile—over $1,000—and this new update has honestly made me consider quitting.

The gameplay feels completely different. Players are constantly moving out of formation, players seem exhausted halfway through matches, and dribbling feels significantly slower and less responsive.

Before the update, the game felt fast, responsive, and exciting. Dribbling was quick, passing felt fluid, and there were multiple ways to create and score goals. Now, the overall gameplay feels much slower.

Most of my matches have become low-scoring games that end 1–0, 1–1, or with similarly low scores. Most goals I see are regular shots. I rarely see players attempting finesse shots or power shots anymore because creating the space and getting the shot off feels so slow.

This isn’t only my experience. I play with a group of players with around 130 OVR teams, and we’ve been discussing the update and experiencing many of the same issues.

I understand that gameplay sometimes needs balancing, but I hope the FC Mobile team considers adjusting the current gameplay. I would especially like to see improvements to dribbling responsiveness, passing speed, player positioning, stamina, and the ability to create different types of scoring opportunities.

The previous gameplay felt much more responsive and enjoyable to us. Please consider the community’s feedback when making future gameplay adjustments.

author: Okkkokoklll
title: Great Game Overall Just Some Dire Improvements
content:
Great game, but it needs a proper league-vs-league matchmaking mode

FC Mobile 27 is a really fun football game, especially with the amount of clubs, players, and game modes available. I really like being able to build my Ultimate Team and compete against other players.

However, I think FC Mobile needs a new mode that lets players choose which real-life league they want to compete in.

For example, if I choose LaLiga, I should be able to select Real Madrid and be matched against someone using another LaLiga club like Barcelona, Atlético Madrid, Sevilla, Athletic Club, etc.

It could work like this:

🏆 League Matchmaking

* Select a league: LaLiga, Premier League, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, etc.
* Select an authentic club from that league.
* Matchmaking only searches for players who selected the same league.
* Real Madrid could face Barcelona, Atlético Madrid, Valencia, etc.
* Premier League players could face Arsenal, Liverpool, Chelsea, Manchester City, etc.
* Each league could have its own leaderboard and season.

There could even be a League Season system where you earn points from every match:

Win: 3 points
Draw: 1 point
Loss: 0 points

At the end of the season, you could receive rewards based on your league position.

This would make matches feel much more like real football instead of simply being random Ultimate Team matchups.

I would especially like to see a “Play in My League” button where I can choose something like:

🇪🇸 LaLiga
→ Real Madrid
→ Find Opponent
→ Barcelona / Atlético / Sevilla / etc.

Thanks for reading!

author: Ea I want to believe in you
title: A few requests
content:
The game isn’t terrible, it’s actually pretty good, but one thing I really wish FC Mobile (That would make it great) had is a season mode. Let us pick any club from any league and play through a full season with them. I’m not asking for a full manager mode with transfers or contracts, just a mode where you play the matches.
There could be a league table, top scorers, awards like the Golden Boot, and tournaments like the Champions League or whatever cups that club would normally play in. Even eFootball has a season mode, so I think FC Mobile could definitely do something similar.

I’d also like a simple Play Now mode where you can choose any club and play against another club controlled by the AI. You could choose the opponent yourself or have it pick a random team. Sometimes you just want to pick your favorite club and play normal football.
